item.description:

item.title: AI advice made people less accurate but more confident – sudy
item.description:
📝 Image by: Canva TL;DRResearchers found AI advice suppressed judgment suspension from 44% to 3%, accuracy from 27% to 9%, while confidence rose from 30% to 76%. Accuracy dropped from 27% to 9%. Confidence, meanwhile, rose from 30% to 76%.
🔗 Read more: https://thenextweb.com/news/ai-advice-suppresses-critical-thinking-wrong-answers-study
